name: Nadir Weibel
title: Professor of Computer Science and Engineering; Director, UCSD XR Lab; Associate Faculty Director, Design Lab

fitReason: A lower-physical-confidence spatial-AI/Human-AI research backup. SweeperBot uses CLIP relevance, Grounding DINO object evidence and multimodal answer generation to select informative rendered viewpoints and answer questions about 3D models. PaperToPlace fine-tunes BERT to associate instructions with workspace objects, then optimizes their presentation in mixed reality. These are concrete spatial interaction methods relevant to perception, accessibility and human-centered AI, but they are not robot-control research results.

physicalEvidence.summary: No attributable physical robot execution was established. SweeperBot evaluates accessible browsing of digital 3D assets; the word Bot does not indicate a physical robot. PaperToPlace presents guidance through a headset while people perform tasks. Older autonomous-vehicle material inspected was a conceptual framework, not a vehicle trial. Do not infer robot deployment from Contextual Robotics affiliation, MR devices, surgical telementoring or a physical-world application.
